intent: Teach beyond-fence ball position; simultaneous permitted rugby actions; field-hockey context; ongoing golf learning at club; race starting beside bridge; entry not victory; eight teams not eight people; team choosing captain without reversing roles. Six coded changing models and two evidence tasks; no new bitmap needed for these relations.

workshop.title: 看准位置、同时动作和参赛信息
workshop.instruction: 移动球和起点、换人数单位、检查参赛与获胜；只保留原句明确的信息。
